title: 第19章 逆天珠的大方第20章 再次突破
content_zh:
经过一夜的努力，终于把叶净心的问题解决了，而且修为更是达到了锻体九层天巅峰。
马上就可以步入先天。
估计再双修几次就可以步入先天了。
毕竟不是谁都可以一晚上坚持三个时辰的战斗！
如果让其他女人知道，估计得羡慕死。
但是对于亲身经历的人就不一定了，现在叶净心可还是瘫软在床上，一动不动呢。
可见战况的惨烈。
而萧天却是雄赳赳气昂昂，一点疲惫感都没有。
当萧天走出房门。
下面的仆人看到萧天低头交谈。
有个胆子大的下人走上来问道“二公子，你用的什么方法，那方面那么强大？”
说完还不忘看看。
萧天也是一愣，难道昨晚表现得很明显吗？
于是疑惑的问道“昨晚的动静很大？”
“何止大，简直是震耳欲聋，后来还是家族把我们都撵出碧荷居的。”
回答道
萧天尴尬的笑了笑，然后对着那个下人道“公子我天赋异禀，你们学不来！”
然后萧天得意的走回房间，然后看见叶净心已经穿戴整齐，正呆呆的看着镜子前的自己！
经过了萧天一晚上的滋润，皮肤变得白里透红，比起之前少女的青涩，现在增加了些许成熟的韵味，更加的诱人。
而关键让叶净心自己看呆的原因是，自己脸上的印记已经消失不见，整张脸犹如天作，魅力无限。

然后听到响声看向外，激动得有些颤抖。
见状，萧天立马说道“心儿不要激动，之前我就跟你说过，你的事情可以解决。
你看，为夫没有骗你吧！
而且你尝试着说句话看看！”
听到萧天这话，叶净心又是一怔，“难道…我自己都没说过话，怎么说……”
叶净心心里着急的想着。
然后努力的张口说道“夫…君…”
说完眼泪就如同珍珠般掉落，这是激动的。
突然站起来抱住了萧天。
萧天安抚道“你这是刚刚治愈，可能还有点不习惯，过一些时间就好了”
叶净心点点头，轻声应道“嗯”
“其实还有最大的变化难道心儿你没有发现吗？”
萧天继续道
“那～里？”
叶净心疑惑道。
content_en:
After a night of hard work, Ye Jingxin's problem was finally solved, and his cultivation reached the peak of the ninth level of body training.
You can enter Xiantian right away.
It is estimated that after a few more double cultivations, I will be able to enter Xiantian.
After all, not everyone can fight for three hours in one night!
If other women knew about it, they would probably die of envy.
But this is not necessarily the case for those who have experienced it personally. Now Ye Jingxin is still slumped on the bed, motionless.
It can be seen how tragic the battle was.
Xiao Tian, ​​on the other hand, was vigorous and high-spirited, not feeling tired at all.
When Xiao Tian walked out of the room.
The servant below saw Xiao Tian lowering his head and talking.
A brave servant came up and asked, "Second Young Master, what method did you use to make it so powerful?"
Don’t forget to take a look when you’re done.
Xiao Tian was also stunned. Was it obvious last night?
So he asked doubtfully, "There was a lot of noise last night?"
"It was not only big, it was deafening. Later, it was our family that kicked us all out of Biheju."
replied
Xiao Tian smiled awkwardly, and then said to the servant, "Young master, I am extremely talented, you can't learn from me!"
Then Xiao Tian walked back to the room proudly, and saw Ye Jingxin fully dressed and looking blankly at himself in front of the mirror!
After a night of moisturizing by Xiao Tian, ​​the skin became white and rosy. Compared with the girlish greenness before, it now has a slightly mature charm and is more attractive.
The key reason why Ye Jingxin was dumbfounded was that the mark on her face had disappeared, and her entire face looked as if it was made in heaven, with infinite charm.
Then he heard a noise and looked outside, trembling with excitement.
Seeing this, Xiao Tian immediately said, "Don't get excited, I told you before that your matter can be solved.
Look, my husband didn’t lie to you, right?
And try to say something! "
Hearing Xiao Tian's words, Ye Jingxin was startled again, "Could it be...I haven't said anything myself, how can I say..."
Ye Jingxin thought anxiously.
Then he opened his mouth with great effort and said, "Husband...jun..."
After saying that, tears fell like pearls, which was so exciting.
Suddenly stood up and hugged Xiao Tian.
Xiao Tian comforted him, "You have just been cured. You may still be a little unaccustomed to it. You will be fine after some time."
Ye Jingxin nodded and responded softly, "Yeah."
"Actually, there is the biggest change, haven't you noticed Xin'er?"
Xiao Tian continued
"Where?"
Ye Jingxin said doubtfully.
